faqData.q: What is your main area of expertise?
faqData.a: As an Artificial Intelligence student at Helwan International Technological University, I specialize in Computer Vision (YOLO-based object detection), Natural Language Processing, and Python-based automation and data analysis.

faqData.q: Are you available for internships or freelance collaborations?
faqData.a: Absolutely. I'm currently freelancing and open to internships, research collaborations, and freelance projects in AI, computer vision, and automation.

faqData.q: What is your typical tech stack?
faqData.a: For AI and ML work, I primarily use Python with PyTorch, TensorFlow, and OpenCV. For automation and data work, I rely on Pandas, NumPy, and Bash scripting, alongside JavaScript for browser-based tools.

faqData.q: Do you have experience with real-world or client projects?
faqData.a: Yes — as a freelance developer and AI Data Labeling Specialist at Outlier, plus internships at GUPCO and PMS, I've delivered automation, data analysis, and annotation-pipeline work in production settings.

faqData.q: How can we start a partnership or project?
faqData.a: The most efficient way is to use the contact form above or reach out directly via email at mi7418298@gmail.com. I'm usually able to respond within 24 hours to discuss how I can help with your project.
